full_prompt_en: A detailed pixel-art landscape imagines a small settlement of stacked, weathered houses on rocky pillars beside a tidal shore at dusk. On the left, narrow ocher and terracotta rooms rise in irregular tiers above pale stone foundations, with tiny dark windows, balconies, and patches of climbing greenery. A slimmer gray-beige tower stands near the center, while smaller buildings and trees recede along the shoreline to the right. The lower foreground is a muddy wet path cut by shallow reflective channels; their broken bands of blue and warm peach lead the eye toward the distant water. Across the sky, a large pale moon hangs behind thin blue-gray cloud streaks. Warm salmon and coral light spreads near the horizon, cooling to dusty teal and slate blue higher up. The architecture is eccentric but readable, formed from small hard-edged blocks and clusters of pixels rather than smooth brush blending. Rust, sage, olive, cream, and steel-blue flecks build masonry, foliage, and rock with many tiny tonal changes. Water reflections are fragmented into horizontal dashes, and far structures lose detail in a soft haze even though their edges remain pixel based. The composition gives the left group most of the vertical weight, with a gentler sequence of smaller forms tapering rightward; open sky and tidal flats provide breathing room around the dense settlement. Light is low and diffuse, glowing softly on the west-facing walls and in puddles, while shaded facades remain cool and subdued. The overall mood is contemplative and slightly fantastical, like a carefully crafted game-world vista seen during a quiet evening tide.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅细密像素风景想象黄昏潮岸旁一处层层叠起的风化房屋聚落，房屋立在岩石柱上。左侧，狭窄赭黄和赤陶色房间在浅色石基上不规则升起，带微小暗窗、阳台和攀爬绿植。一座较细的灰米色塔立在中央附近，较小建筑与树木沿岸向右退远。下方前景是一条泥湿道路，被浅浅反光水道切开；破碎蓝色与暖桃色条带引导视线到远水。天空中，大而浅的月亮挂在细蓝灰云纹后。暖鲑粉和珊瑚光布满地平线附近，向上冷却为灰青绿与板岩蓝。建筑奇巧却清楚，由小块硬边像素和像素簇构成，而不是平滑笔触晕染。铁锈、鼠尾草、橄榄、奶油和钢蓝细点以大量微小明暗变化组成砖石、叶丛和岩石。水中倒影分裂成水平短划，远处房屋在柔雾里失去细节，但边缘仍基于像素。构图让左侧群落承受大部分竖向重量，较小形体序列向右温和收细；开放天空和潮滩为密聚房屋留出呼吸空间。光线低而漫射，在朝西墙面和水坑上轻柔发亮，阴影立面则冷而低调。整体沉思且略带奇幻，像安静晚潮时刻细心制作的游戏世界风景。
style_prompt_en: Detailed pixel-art landscape work builds forms from numerous small, hard-edged color clusters rather than continuous gradients. Rust orange, ocher, dusty cream, sage, olive, slate blue, and muted teal mingle in dithered patches, while thin coral-peach bands warm a cooler upper field. Near surfaces carry dense tiny rectangular marks and broken outlines; distant layers simplify and fade into softly stepped haze. Reflections appear as short horizontal pixel dashes interrupted by dark ground. Low diffuse light picks out warm-facing planes without sharp cast shadows, leaving shaded sides in cool blue-gray. The composition concentrates high-contrast vertical stacks on one side and tapers them into smaller shapes, with generous open sky and flat lower channels balancing the density. Its rhythm comes from repeating block modules at different scales and from the contrast between intricate constructed detail and broad tranquil color fields.
style_prompt_zh: 细密像素风景作品以大量小型硬边色簇，而非连续渐变，建立形体。铁锈橙、赭黄、灰奶油、鼠尾草、橄榄、板岩蓝与暗青绿在抖点片块中混合，细珊瑚桃色带温暖更冷的上方区域。近处表面带密集细小矩形标记与破碎轮廓；远层简化，退入软阶梯式雾气。反光以被暗地打断的水平短像素划呈现。低位漫射光拣出朝暖光平面，却没有锐利投影，阴面保持冷蓝灰。构图把高反差竖向叠层聚于一侧，向外逐渐收为较小形状，再用宽裕开阔天空和平坦下方水道平衡密度。节奏来自不同尺度方块模块的重复，也来自精细构造细节与宁静宽色域之间的反差。
theme_en: A cluster of weathered towers stands beside a tidal shore beneath a pale moon
theme_zh: 淡月之下，风化塔屋聚落立在潮滩旁
name: Pixelscape
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
